purpose: Expand official Austrian mobile-provider customer benefits without paid extraction or bypassing Slack approval
scope: Public customer-benefit pages, not a comprehensive mobile-tariff comparison

heldInValidation.reason: Specific Vienna participation not established by captured detail block

capture.verificationMethod: Reparse and pipeline-test real HTTP-200 snapshots without additional network calls

publicCatalogLimitations.drei: All 22 qualifying indexed detail URLs read. Expired or conflicting terms, regional benefits outside Vienna and incomplete trial-follow-up conditions held. No promise of all private or future offers.
publicCatalogLimitations.a1: Actual direct HTTP 200 now, unlike previous generic 403. Six public discount teasers retained as source evidence only; full selected products, code eligibility, renewal pricing or other app conditions not established. Alcohol excluded.
publicCatalogLimitations.magenta: Public overview is not the complete Moments app catalog. No offer invented from logos, generic 1+1 marketing, potential monthly savings or data-pack activation dates without a stated price.
publicCatalogLimitations.hot: 10 EUR HOFER voucher only after first number porting AND subsequent tariff-package booking; once per number, at most five per person. Not a general reward for every existing HoT customer.
publicCatalogLimitations.otherProviders: spusu/yesss and other brands not asserted to have the same benefits as their underlying network. No complete partner catalog verified or adapter coverage claimed for these brands.

safety.newSlackDelivery: not claimed; no manual dispatch or test send
safety.votes: zero for new carrier candidates, retained through Slack normalization
safety.dates: no invented source publication date or expiry; verification time is separate
safety.requests: single paced direct-HTTP lane, 48 requests maximum, robots respected, 401/403/429 pauses persist and cannot be shortened by concurrent commits

localEvidence: output/carrier-benefits-2026-11-02 (raw captures, pipeline validation, tests and final status)
